testo:
■ Whenever one of your opponent's creatures attacks you, you may cast a spell that has "shield trigger" from your hand for no cost.
■ Mana Arms 7: Whenever you cast a spell from your hand, if you have 7 or more water cards in your mana zone, you may cast it from your graveyard for no cost.
Double Breaker

■ マナ武装7：自分の手札から呪文を唱えた時、マナゾーンに水のカードが7枚以上あれば、その呪文を墓地からコストを支払わずに唱えてもよい。
